# Analytics & Insights

The analytics dashboard helps you understand your business performance and make data-driven decisions.

## Accessing Analytics

Your **Overview** page provides key metrics and charts. Here's what you'll find:

## Key Metrics

At a glance, your dashboard shows:

- **Total Reservations** — The total number of bookings your business has received
- **Confirmed Reservations** — How many bookings have been confirmed
- **Total Customers** — The number of unique customers who have booked with you
- **Revenue** — Total revenue from paid reservations (if applicable)

## Charts & Trends

Visual insights help you spot patterns:

### Reservation Trends
A chart showing your reservation volume over time. Use this to:
- Identify your busiest periods
- Spot seasonal trends
- Plan staffing and resources accordingly

### Popular Service Types
See which services are most in demand. This helps you:
- Focus marketing on popular services
- Consider expanding high-demand offerings
- Adjust pricing based on demand

### Customer Activity
Track customer engagement:
- New vs. returning customers
- Booking frequency
- Most active customers

## Using Insights to Grow

Here are some ways to use your analytics:

1. **Optimize your schedule** — If certain time slots are consistently popular, consider extending your hours or adding staff during peak times.
2. **Adjust pricing** — High-demand services might warrant premium pricing, while less popular services could benefit from promotions.
3. **Improve service offerings** — If a service type is rarely booked, consider updating its description, adjusting the price, or replacing it with something more appealing.
4. **Retain customers** — Track returning customers and consider loyalty programs or special offers to keep them coming back.

## Customer Management

Navigate to **Customers** in the sidebar to see everyone who has booked with your business:

- View customer contact information
- See their reservation history
- Track how often they visit
- Identify your most loyal customers

## AI-powered Insights

For deeper analytics driven by **machine learning**, open **Insights** in the sidebar. The pipeline analyzes your historical data to provide:

- **Customer Segmentation** — Groups customers (e.g. Champions, At Risk, Lost) from recency, frequency, and spend patterns.
- **Cancellation Prediction** — Flags bookings more likely to cancel so you can follow up or adjust policy.
- **Demand Forecasting** — Estimates reservation volume for the next several days for staffing and planning.

Learn more in the [Insights](./insights) guide.

## Next Steps

Explore the [FAQ](../general/faq) for answers to common questions, or visit [Contact & Support](../general/contact-support) if you need help.

# Getting Started as a Business

Welcome to Slotera! This guide will help you set up your business and start accepting reservations.

## Creating Your Business Account

1. Visit the [registration page](/auth/register) and select **Business** as your account type.
2. Fill in your business details:
   - **Business Name** — The name customers will see
   - **Your Name** — Your name as the business owner/manager
   - **Email Address** — For login and business communications
   - **Phone Number** — For customer contact
   - **Password** — Secure your account with a strong password
3. Agree to the terms and conditions, then click **Register**.
4. You'll be redirected to your business dashboard.

## Setting Up Your Profile

After registration, complete your business profile to make your listing attractive to customers:

### Business Information

Navigate to **Profile** → **Info** to set up:

- **Business Description** — Tell customers what you offer
- **Address** — Your physical location
- **Contact Information** — Phone, email, and website
- **Business Logo** — Upload your logo for brand recognition
- **Cover Image** — A banner image for your reservation page

### Business Hours

Navigate to **Profile** → **Hours** to configure:

- **Operating Hours** — Set your open and close times for each day of the week
- **Days Off** — Mark days when you're closed
- Customers will only be able to book during your operating hours.

### Booking Settings

Navigate to **Profile** → **Booking** to configure:

- **Booking Window** — How far in advance customers can book
- **Auto-accept** — Default behavior for reservations (see also per–service-type options under **Types**)
- **Cancellation Policy** — Set your cancellation rules

## Your Business Dashboard

The **Overview** page gives you a snapshot of your business:

- **Today's Reservations** — What's coming up today
- **Pending Requests** — Reservation requests awaiting your response
- **Key Stats** — Total reservations, customers, and revenue trends
- **Charts & Trends** — Visual insights into your booking patterns

## Navigating the Platform

Use the sidebar to access the main sections:

- **Overview** — Dashboard with stats and today's schedule
- **Queue** — Walk-in queue management: add parties, call them when ready, track wait times *(visible when the Queue module is enabled)*
- **Orders** — Live kitchen/bar ticket board for real-time order management *(visible when the Ordering module is enabled)*
- **Menu** — Create and manage menus, categories, items, and the item library *(visible when the Ordering module is enabled)*
- **Insights** — AI-powered demand forecasts, customer segments, and cancellation risk (see [Insights](./insights))
- **Docs** — Product guides inside the dashboard (same content as the help assistant)
- **Reservations** — Full list of all bookings
- **Requests** — Pending reservation requests to review
- **Schedule** — Visual timeline of all reservations
- **Customers** — People who have booked with you
- **Staff** — Manage your team members
- **Profile** — Business info, hours, service types, and booking settings
- **Settings** — Account and profile configuration

<Callout type="info">
Queue and Ordering sidebar items only appear when those modules are enabled for your business. Contact support if you'd like to activate them.
</Callout>

## Your Public Reservation Page

Once your profile is set up, customers can book with you at:

```
/reserve/your-business-slug
```

Share this link on your website, social media, or with customers directly.

## Next Steps

Now that your profile is set up, [create your service types](./managing-services) so customers know what they can book.

# Handling Reservations

Managing reservations efficiently is key to running a successful business on Slotera.

## Reservation Requests

When a customer books, the reservation may start as **pending** or **confirmed**:

- **Per service type** — On **Profile** → **Types**, each service can enable **Pending requests**. If enabled, new bookings for that service appear under **Requests** until you accept them.
- **Global booking settings** — **Profile** → **Booking** controls defaults such as how far ahead customers can book and cancellation expectations.

### Reviewing Requests

1. Navigate to **Requests** in the sidebar.
2. You'll see all pending reservation requests with:
   - Customer name and contact info
   - Requested date and time
   - Service type
   - Any notes from the customer
   - **Custom form** answers, if you configured extra fields on the service type
3. For each request, you can:
   - **Accept** — Confirm the reservation
   - **Reject** — Decline the reservation

<Callout type="info">
Responding to requests promptly improves the customer experience and helps build trust with your clientele.
</Callout>

## Email confirmations and calendar invites

When your environment is configured for outbound email, customers receive a **confirmation email** after a relevant booking is created or updated. That email can include:

- Reservation summary (business, service, time, guests)
- **ICS calendar attachment** — Add the booking to their calendar
- **Google Meet link** — For **online** service types, when Google Calendar is connected (see [Managing Service Types](./managing-services))

## Managing All Reservations

Navigate to **Reservations** in the sidebar to see a complete list of all bookings.

### Filtering and Searching

- **Filter by status** — View only confirmed, pending, completed, or cancelled reservations
- **Search** — Find reservations by customer name, date, or service type
- **Sort** — Order by date, status, or customer name

### Viewing Reservation Details

Click on any reservation to see:
- Full customer information
- Booking details (date, time, service type)
- Payment status
- Notes and special requests
- **Meeting link** (for online services)
- Reservation history

### Updating a Reservation

You can modify an existing reservation:
1. Click on the reservation to open its details.
2. Click **Edit**.
3. Update the date, time, or other details.
4. Save your changes.

### Cancelling a Reservation

If you need to cancel a booking:
1. Open the reservation details.
2. Click **Cancel**.
3. Confirm the cancellation.

## Schedule View

The **Schedule** page provides a visual timeline of your reservations:

- See all bookings laid out on a timeline
- Quickly identify busy and available time slots
- Navigate between days to plan ahead
- Click on a reservation in the timeline for quick access to its details

## Auto-Accept vs. Manual Review

You can combine **Profile** → **Booking** defaults with **per–service-type** pending settings:

| Approach | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| **Immediate confirmation** | Disable **Pending requests** on the service type so eligible bookings are confirmed when submitted (subject to availability). |
| **Manual review** | Enable **Pending requests** on services that need approval; use **Requests** to accept or reject. |

## Next Steps

Learn how to [manage your staff](./staff-management) and delegate reservation management to your team.

# Insights

The **Insights** page uses **artificial intelligence** and **machine learning** to go beyond the charts on your Overview. Models learn from your historical reservation data to surface forecasts, segments, and risk signals you can act on.

## Getting Started

Navigate to **Insights** in the sidebar. If this is your first time, you'll see an empty state — click **Run Pipeline** to generate your first set of insights.

The pipeline takes a few seconds to run and will:
1. Load all your reservation and customer data
2. Engineer features (booking patterns, customer behavior, time-series trends)
3. Train three ML models
4. Display the results on the dashboard

## Customer Segmentation

Your customers are automatically grouped into segments using **RFM analysis** (Recency, Frequency, Monetary value) and K-Means clustering:

| Segment | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **Champions** | Recent, frequent, high-spending customers — your best clients |
| **Loyal Customers** | Regular visitors with consistent booking patterns |
| **Potential Loyalists** | Moderately recent with decent spending — could become loyal |
| **At Risk** | Previously active customers who haven't booked recently |
| **Lost Customers** | Haven't booked in a long time with low frequency |

### How to use this
- **Champions** — Offer exclusive perks or early access to new services
- **At Risk** — Send re-engagement emails or special offers to win them back
- **Lost Customers** — Consider a win-back campaign with a compelling discount

## Cancellation Prediction

A **gradient-boosting** machine learning model (LightGBM) is trained on your resolved reservations (completed vs. cancelled) to predict which future bookings are most likely to be cancelled.

### Key metrics shown
- **AUC-ROC** — How well the model distinguishes cancellations from completions (closer to 1.0 is better)
- **Precision** — Of the reservations flagged as likely cancellations, how many actually were
- **Recall** — Of all actual cancellations, how many the model caught
- **F1 Score** — The harmonic mean of precision and recall

### Top risk factors
The chart shows which features most influence the model's predictions. Common top factors include:
- **Lead time** — Reservations booked far in advance are more likely to be cancelled
- **Payment status** — Paid reservations are much less likely to be cancelled
- **Customer history** — Customers with past cancellations are more likely to cancel again

### How to use this
- Consider requiring deposits for high-risk bookings
- Send confirmation reminders for reservations booked far in advance
- Flag repeat cancellers for special attention

## Demand Forecasting

The demand forecast predicts your expected reservation volume for the next 7 days using historical patterns, day-of-week effects, and rolling averages.

### What you'll see
- **Bar chart** showing predicted daily reservations (weekdays in blue, weekends in purple)
- **Total expected** reservations for the week
- **Busiest / Quietest day** predictions
- **Weekday vs. weekend** averages

### How to use this
- **Staff scheduling** — Schedule more staff on predicted busy days
- **Inventory planning** — Order supplies based on expected volume
- **Marketing** — Run promotions on predicted quiet days to boost traffic

## Running the Pipeline

Click **Run Pipeline** at the top of the Insights page to refresh all predictions with the latest data. The pipeline typically completes in a few seconds.

Results are cached and will persist until you run the pipeline again.

## Next Steps

- Check [Analytics & Insights](./analytics) for basic dashboard metrics on **Overview**
- Visit the [FAQ](../general/faq) for common questions

# Managing Service Types

Service types define what customers can book with your business. For example, a hair salon might have "Haircut", "Coloring", and "Styling" as service types, while a restaurant might have "Table for 2", "Table for 4", and "Private Dining".

## Viewing Your Service Types

Navigate to **Profile** → **Types** to see all your current service types.

## Creating a Service Type

1. Go to **Profile** → **Types**.
2. Click **Add Service Type**.
3. Fill in the **Details** tab:
   - **Name** — The name of the service (e.g., "Haircut", "Consultation")
   - **Description** — A brief description of what the service includes
   - **Duration** — How long the service typically takes (used for scheduling and, for online services, the calendar event length)
   - **Price** — The cost of the service (if applicable)
   - **Capacity** — How many customers can book this service at the same time
   - **Color** — Display color for calendars and lists
4. Optional **Booking behavior**:
   - **Require payment** — When enabled, customers may need to pay a deposit or full amount at booking (Stripe), depending on your configuration.
   - **Online (video) service** — Mark the service as held online. When Google Calendar is connected for your business, Slotera can create a **Google Meet** link and attach it to the reservation and confirmation email. Connect Google from **Profile** → **Types** (connection banner) if you use online services.
   - **Pending requests** — When enabled, new bookings for this service start as **pending** until you accept them in **Requests**. When disabled, eligible bookings are **confirmed** immediately (still subject to your global booking rules).
5. Optional **Custom form** tab — Add extra fields (text, number, select, etc.) that customers must fill when booking this service. Responses are stored on the reservation.
6. Click **Save** to create the service type.

## Google Calendar and Meet

For **online** service types, Meet links are created only if your business has connected **Google Calendar** (OAuth). Use the connect action on **Profile** → **Types** to authorize Slotera. Without a connection, online services still work, but no Meet link is generated automatically.

## Editing a Service Type

1. Go to **Profile** → **Types**.
2. Find the service type you want to edit.
3. Click the **Edit** button.
4. Make your changes and click **Save**.

## Deleting a Service Type

1. Go to **Profile** → **Types**.
2. Find the service type you want to remove.
3. Click the **Delete** button.
4. Confirm the deletion.

<Callout type="warn">
Deleting a service type will not cancel existing reservations of that type, but customers will no longer be able to book it.
</Callout>

## Guests and public booking

Customers booking from your public page can specify **guest count** where the flow supports it. Capacity on the service type helps control how many spots each slot represents.

## Best Practices

- **Be descriptive** — Clear names and descriptions help customers choose the right service.
- **Set accurate durations** — Prevents scheduling conflicts and sets the right length for online calendar events.
- **Keep prices updated** — Ensure your listed prices match your current rates.
- **Review regularly** — Update your service types as your offerings change.

## Next Steps

With your services set up, learn how to [handle incoming reservations](./handling-reservations).

# Menu & Ordering

The Ordering module lets you run a digital menu and a real-time ticket board for your kitchen and bar. Customers scan a QR code (or follow a link) to browse your menu, add items to a cart, and place an order — no app download required.

<Callout type="info">
The Ordering module must be enabled for your business before the Menu and Orders pages appear in your sidebar.
</Callout>

## Menu Management

Navigate to **Menu** in the sidebar to create and manage your menus.

### Creating a Menu

1. Click **New Menu**.
2. Enter a name (e.g. "Dinner Menu") and an optional description (e.g. "Available from 6 pm–11 pm").
3. Click **Create**.

You can create multiple menus (e.g. Lunch, Dinner, Happy Hour). Only **active** menus are shown to customers. Use the **Activate / Deactivate** button on the menu header to control visibility.

### Categories

Each menu is organized into categories (e.g. Starters, Mains, Desserts, Cocktails).

1. Select a menu from the tabs at the top.
2. Click **+ Category** in the menu header.
3. Enter a category name and click **Create**.

### Adding Items

1. Click **+ Item** inside a category, or click **Library** to add from your saved item library.
2. Fill in the item details:
   - **Name** — What customers will see
   - **Description** — Optional details (ingredients, allergens, etc.)
   - **Price** — Item price in euros
   - **Prep time** — Estimated preparation time in minutes (shown to customers)
   - **Routing** — Which station fulfills this item (see [Routing](#routing) below)
3. Click **Add Item**.

### Managing Item Availability

Each item has an **86** button (restaurant shorthand for "out of stock"). Clicking it marks the item as unavailable — it will appear crossed out on the staff view and be hidden from customers. Click **Restore** to make it available again.

---

## Item Library

The item library is a business-wide collection of reusable item templates. Use it to avoid re-entering the same item details across multiple menus or categories.

### Saving an Item to the Library

On any item row, click the **bookmark icon**. This copies the item's name, description, price, and routing tag into the library.

### Opening the Library

Click the **Library** button in the top-right of the Menu page to open the library panel. From here you can:
- Browse all saved templates
- Create new library items directly with **+ New**
- Edit or delete existing library entries

### Adding a Library Item to a Category

1. On a category header, click **Library**.
2. The library panel opens with a **+** button next to each item.
3. Click **+** next to the item you want — it is copied into that category as a new menu item.

<Callout type="info">
Adding from the library creates an independent copy. Editing a library template later does not change items already placed in a menu — this is intentional to prevent unexpected changes during live service.
</Callout>

---

## Routing

Every menu item has a **routing tag**: `kitchen`, `bar`, or `any`. This controls which column the item appears in on the staff ticket board.

| Routing tag | Ticket board column |
|-------------|---------------------|
| `kitchen` | Kitchen only |
| `bar` | Bar only |
| `any` | Both Kitchen and Bar |

Set the routing tag when creating or editing an item. For example, food dishes → `kitchen`; cocktails and drinks → `bar`; bottled water → `any`.

---

## Orders Ticket Board

Navigate to **Orders** in the sidebar to see the live ticket board.

### Board Layout

The board is split into two columns — **Kitchen** and **Bar** — each showing only the orders relevant to that station based on the items' routing tags.

Each ticket shows:
- Table number (if provided)
- Time since the order was placed
- Items for that station (with modifiers and notes)
- Current status

### Status Transitions

Orders move through the following statuses:

| Status | Meaning | Next action |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| **Received** | Order just came in | Start Preparing |
| **Preparing** | Kitchen/bar is working on it | Mark Ready |
| **Ready** | Done, waiting to be served | Mark Served |
| **Served** | Delivered to the customer | — |
| **Cancelled** | Order was cancelled | — |

Click the action button on each ticket to advance it to the next status. The board updates in real time across all open browser tabs — no refresh needed.

### New Order Toasts

When a new order arrives, a Sonner toast notification appears at the bottom of the screen showing the table number and total. This works even if you are on a different page in the dashboard while the Orders tab is open in another tab.

---

## Pausing Orders

If you need to temporarily stop accepting new orders (e.g. kitchen is full, closing early), click **Pause Orders** in the top-right of the Orders page.

- A red banner appears on the staff board as a reminder
- Customers visiting your menu page see a **"Ordering is temporarily unavailable"** banner
- The cart checkout button is disabled — customers cannot submit new orders
- The API returns an error if an order is submitted directly while paused

Click **Resume Orders** to go back online.

---

## Customer Flow

Customers do not need an account to place an order.

1. **Reach the menu** — via a QR code at the table (pointing to `/menu/{your-business-id}?table=X`) or a direct link
2. **Browse** — scroll through categories, tap an item to see details and modifiers
3. **Add to cart** — select modifiers (if any), add notes, choose quantity
4. **Checkout** — tap the cart bar at the bottom, optionally enter table number and order notes, then place the order
5. **Track** — after placing, the order status page auto-refreshes every 10 seconds and reflects the current status from the ticket board

To get a QR link for a specific table, use the **QR URL** helper under the menu settings (available via the API at `GET /api/ordering/{business_id}/qr-url/{table_identifier}`).

---

# Staff Management

If you have a team, you can add staff members to help manage your business on Slotera.

## Viewing Your Staff

Navigate to **Staff** in the sidebar to see all team members associated with your business.

Each staff member's card shows:
- Name and contact information
- Role (Owner, Manager, or Staff)
- When they were added

## Staff Roles

Slotera supports the following roles:

| Role | Permissions |
|------|-------------|
| **Owner** | Full access to all business features, including billing and account deletion. Only one owner per business. |
| **Manager** | Can manage reservations, customers, staff, and business settings. Cannot delete the business or change the owner. |
| **Staff** | Can view and manage reservations and customers. Limited access to business settings. |

## Adding Staff Members

Staff members are added when they register with your business. As the business owner or manager, you can:

1. Go to **Staff** in the sidebar.
2. View all current team members.
3. Update roles as needed.

## Changing a Staff Member's Role

1. Go to **Staff** in the sidebar.
2. Find the staff member you want to update.
3. Click the **Edit** button or role dropdown.
4. Select the new role.
5. Confirm the change.

## Removing a Staff Member

1. Go to **Staff** in the sidebar.
2. Find the staff member you want to remove.
3. Click the **Remove** button.
4. Confirm the removal.

<Callout type="warn">
Removing a staff member revokes their access to your business dashboard. This action cannot be undone—you would need to re-add them if you change your mind.
</Callout>

## Next Steps

Want to understand how your business is performing? Check out [Analytics & Insights](./analytics).

# Contact & Support

We're here to help! Whether you have a question, need technical support, or want to provide feedback, there are several ways to reach us.

## Getting Help

Before reaching out, check these resources:

1. **This Documentation** — Open **Docs** in your business dashboard for full guides.
2. **[FAQ](./faq)** — Answers to the most frequently asked questions.
3. **In-app Help** — Look for tooltips and help text throughout the platform (including the docs assistant where available).

## Contact Us

If you can't find what you're looking for, get in touch:

### Contact Form

Use the **Contact Us** button found on the homepage or in the footer. Fill in:
- Your name
- Email address
- Subject
- Your message

We aim to respond to all inquiries within 24 hours.

### Email Support

Reach us directly at our support email for:
- Technical issues
- Account problems
- Billing questions
- Feature requests

## Reporting Issues

If you encounter a bug or technical issue:

1. Note what you were trying to do when the issue occurred.
2. Take a screenshot if possible.
3. Contact us with:
   - A description of the problem
   - Steps to reproduce the issue
   - Your browser and device information
   - Any error messages you saw

## Feedback & Suggestions

We love hearing from our users! If you have ideas for improving Slotera:

- Use the contact form to submit feature requests
- Let us know what's working well and what could be better
- Share your experience to help us improve the platform for everyone

# Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to the most common questions about Slotera.

## General

### What is Slotera?

Slotera is an all-in-one platform that connects businesses and customers through a simple, intuitive reservation system. Businesses can manage their bookings, schedules, and customers, while customers can easily find and book appointments.

### Is Slotera free to use?

- **For customers**: Yes! Creating an account and making reservations is completely free.
- **For businesses**: We offer different pricing plans to suit your needs. Visit our [For Businesses](/for-businesses) page for details.

### What types of businesses can use Slotera?

Slotera is designed for any business that takes appointments or reservations, including:
- Restaurants and cafes
- Hair salons and barbershops
- Spas and wellness centers
- Medical and dental offices
- Consulting firms
- Fitness studios
- And many more!

## Customer Questions

### How do I make a reservation?

Visit a business's reservation page, select a service type, choose your preferred date and time, and confirm your booking. See our [Making a Reservation](../customers/making-a-reservation) guide for detailed steps.

### Can I cancel or modify my reservation?

Yes, you can view, modify, or cancel your reservations at any time from your dashboard. Go to **Reservations** and click on the booking you want to change. See [Managing Reservations](../customers/managing-reservations) for more details.

### How do I know if my reservation is confirmed?

After submitting a reservation, you can check its status in your **Reservations** or **Requests** section. Statuses include Pending, Confirmed, Rejected, Cancelled, and Completed. You may also receive a **confirmation email** with a calendar invite when email is enabled for the business.

### I forgot my password. What do I do?

Go to the [login page](/auth/login), click **Forgot Password**, and enter your email address. You'll receive a link to reset your password.

## Business Questions

### How do I set up my business profile?

After registering as a business, go to **Profile** in the sidebar to set up your business information, hours, service types, and booking settings. See [Getting Started as a Business](../businesses/getting-started) for a complete guide.

### Can I have multiple staff members manage my business?

Yes! You can add staff members with different roles (Owner, Manager, Staff) to help manage your business. See [Staff Management](../businesses/staff-management) for details.

### How do I manage incoming reservation requests?

Go to **Requests** in the sidebar to see pending reservations. You can accept or reject each request. You can also mark individual **service types** to require approval (pending) or confirm immediately—see [Handling Reservations](../businesses/handling-reservations).

### Do customers get email when they book?

When outbound email is configured for your deployment, customers receive confirmation messages that can include reservation details, an **ICS** calendar file, and—for **online** services with Google connected—a **Google Meet** link. See [Handling Reservations](../businesses/handling-reservations).

### Can customers pay online?

Yes, Slotera supports online payments through Stripe. You can configure payment settings for your service types to require deposits or full payment at booking time.

### What are Insights?

**Insights** runs **machine learning** models on your data for segmentation, cancellation risk, and short-term demand forecasting. See the [Insights](../businesses/insights) guide.

## Technical Questions

### What browsers are supported?

Slotera works on all modern browsers, including:
- Google Chrome
- Mozilla Firefox
- Safari
- Microsoft Edge

### Is my data secure?

Yes. We use industry-standard security practices, including:
- Encrypted passwords (bcrypt hashing)
- Secure authentication (JWT tokens)
- HTTPS encryption for all data in transit
- Secure payment processing through Stripe

### Can I access Slotera on my phone?
Yes! The platform is fully responsive and works great on mobile devices, tablets, and desktops.
